/* cppi::4652189a10e97a60e11cb31e54fb6a1596e8abae96a82fb2674efcb643e3762d */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 20:08:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

     m.id_model_portfolio,

     on (s.id_model_portfolio = m.id_model_portfolio or s.id_model_portfolio = t.trading_portfolio_code)
     and s.business_date = t.business_date

WITH TYPE_LEVEL_HIERARCHY AS (
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'ACCOUNT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'POOL'
				when node_level = 4 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 5 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 6 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 7 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 8 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) AS HIERARCHY_LEVEL,
		'ACCOUNT' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		account,
		pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account
	where business_date = '2025-06-05'
	UNION ALL
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'POOL'
				when node_level = 3 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 4 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 5 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 7 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) AS HIERARCHY_LEVEL,
		'POOL' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_pool
	where business_date = '2025-06-05'
	UNION ALL
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		(
			case
				when node_level = 1 then 'CPPIB-ALL'
				when node_level = 2 then 'DEPARTMENT'
				when node_level = 3 then 'STRATEGY'
				when node_level = 4 then 'PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 5 then 'SUB-PROGRAM'
				when node_level = 6 then 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO' else 'UNKNOWN'
			end
		) AS HIERARCHY_LEVEL,
		'RISK' as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,
		'' as pool,
		parent_node_id,
		investment_dept,
		investment_strat,
		program,
		sub_program,
		model_portfolio
	from radar_reporting_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk
	where business_date = '2025-06-05'
	UNION ALL
	select business_date,
		dim_hierarchy_node_id,
		node_level,
		'CUSTOM' AS HIERARCHY_LEVEL,
		hierarchy_type as HIERARCHY_TYPE,
		node_name,
		'' as account,

WITH

        SELECT

        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-31')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
